courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 道碴清篩與再利用
related.transfer: 可遷移「搗固循環產能」與「整正後回沉率」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；道碴清篩與再利用的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Tamping cycle productivity" and "Post-correction settlement ratio" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Ballast cleaning and reuse must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦道碴重排支承恢復與幾何保真；道碴清篩與再利用則以粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ballast rearrangement support recovery and geometry fidelity; Ballast cleaning and reuse centres on gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「搗固循環產能」與「清篩質量守恆」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到道碴清篩與再利用，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「清篩處理速率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Tamping cycle productivity” and “Cleaning mass conservation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ballast cleaning and reuse, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Screening throughput", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道道碴搗固整正
history.text: 本課把軌道道碴搗固整正放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。搗固把道碴重新配置到軌枕下方以恢復支承，起道後的幾何和重載後的幾何並非同一件事；必須把短期整正與長期沉陷追蹤連在一起。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Ballast tamping and track alignment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Tamping rearranges ballast beneath sleepers to restore support, but geometry immediately after lifting differs from geometry after traffic; short-term correction must therefore be connected with settlement monitoring. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
